translation.name: Na Rongorongo Uto nina Jesus Christ

book.name: Luke
book.title: Na Rongorongo Uto nina Jesus Christ Na Tabu Luke Te Gerea

content: Tughulio tana palumu ko mate gea
Tana bona vaghana keri balu vure igaa tara bosa vania Jesus nia na balu vure ni Galilee te matera Pilate tana bona tara sukaghi vania God.
Ma Jesus te bosa tughu vanira me ghaghua, “?Na pukuna tara nea ga na mate te vagha keri ke, mau ghanaghana ighau ke, mara dika vaa gaira, itadira na balu vure ni Galilee?
E taho tua! Inau tu bosa vanighau gatu itaeni, kau mua tughulio tana lei palumiu ke, mi ghau ghua kau mate vaghara gaira.
?Mi vei tara ghaghua ghua ara hangavulu alu na mane ni Siloam kiri tara mate tana bona te kokovo savura na vale datogha? ?Au ghanaghana ighau ke mara dika vaa gaira na vure tara ghahara i Jerusalem?
E taho vaho tua! Inau tu bosa vanighau gatu itaeni, kau mua tughulio tana lei palumiu ke, mi ghau ghua kau mate vaghara gaira.”
Jesus te nia vavaghaha na fig

Keri ge bosaa Jesus vanira na vavaghaha eni, “A sakai na mane te suba asakai na ghai tara holoa nia na fig ta nina leghai. Ma sakai na bongi te tona me va kaoa na fig, keri ge ke ba righi sodoa siki vavanga igaa, hauvaa, me mua righia siki vavangana.

Keri ge bosa vania nina mane lutu leghai, ‘Ko righia eni, me toluni na niulu tu mai kenea na vavangana na ghai eni, mu mua righia siki totobo. Ko toka horua! E taho na pukuna te nia tughuru lee me ghania na utona na pari.’
“Hauvaa, mana mane righitaoni leghai te bosa, ‘Vunaghi, sania ghua gaa a sakai na niulu, mu ku gheli kililia ghua, na pukuna ku soni lololona.
Me ke ba vangagha tana niulu ke mai ke, mana uto vamua, me ke taho so ke, keri ge ko toka kehaa.’”
Jesus te kisua na vaivine te tona roghorogho tana Sabbath
Ta sakai na Sabbath,
a Jesus te taraira na vure tana vale kokoeliulivuti ni Jew.
Ma sakai na vaivine igaa na tidalo dika te ghahaa itatana, me nea me vahaghi e hangavulu alu na niulu, na murina te bake me tona roghorogho.
Tana bona Jesus te righia na vaivine, ge holoa vaa me mai itatana, ge bosa vania, “Vinekama, itaeni ko tatavahale tana vahaghimu.”
Keri ge talui na limana ivuvungana, mana vahaghi te mina me tokeha itatana, me ghoi maemane oli na ghobuna ge holoutoa God.

Mana manesule tana vale kokoeliulivuti ni Jew te righia Jesus te kisua na vaivine tana Sabbath, me rutu sule ngangata, ge bosa vanira na vure subo, “Ke liomiu na kisu ke, ma kau mai kisu ilokani e ono na bongi ta lutu ga, taho tana Sabbath!”

Mana Maghutu te bosa tughu vania, “Ighau rana kiko! ?Siki sakai itamiu ke nia ghaghua nina na buluka pana donkey tana Sabbath ke, me toghi kehaa me hola vaa tana beti ge ke inu? Eo, ighau tau nei keri.
Na vinekama eni te sivuragha tana kemana Abraham, ma Satan te pitia e hangavulu alu na niulu nia na vahaghi. ?Ivei tea, ge ka mua kisua na vahaghina tana Sabbath?”
Ma ghana levunimate tara maa oli heghedira ta nina na bosa tughu, mana vure subo tara nighi togo, na lei totobo uto me haeharegha te nei Jesus.
Na vavaghahana na vuavua pile kikia
Ma Jesus te huatira na vure, “?Na hava te vaghaa na kinakabuna God? ?Na hava ku bosa kaekalea nia te vagha?
E vaghaa eni, a sakai na mane te holaa na vuavuana na ghai te pile kikia
me subaa ta nina leghai. Na vuavua te totolo dato me ghai sule, mana lei manu ni oka tara goni nikudira ga tana lei otona.”
Na vavaghahana na yeast
Jesus te ghoi huatira so na vure, “?Na hava ku vavaghaha nia na kinakabuna God?
E vaghaa na vaivine te holaa na yeast,
me ulea tana pulaoa, polo ge vuha vouvousula dato me gonia ga na berete.”
Na mataula ngingine
Jesus te tona i Jerusalem me haghevighi na lei komu pile mana sule, me taraira ga na vure.
Ma siki sakai tadira te huatia, “?Maghutu, na balu vure sogea vamua kara holaa na vola maurihali?” Ma Jesus te bosatughu vanira,
“Kau tabotabo na liu haghe tana kinakabuna God nia na mataula te ngingine, na pukuna e subo na tinoni tara tabotabo na liu haghe igaa, ma kara mua tangomana.

Na vunaghina na vale ke tughuru me ke vongotia na mataula, mi ghau tau tughuru i pari bebete kau kidikidi ma kau ghaghua, ‘Maghutu, ko hangavia vanighai na mataula!’ “Ma gaia ke bosa tughu vanighau, ‘?Inau tu mua ghilalaghau, ivei tau va butu mai?’
Mi ghau kau bosa, ‘Ighai tai vanga mai inu kolugho, mo taraighai tana komumami!’
Ma gaia ke ghoi ghaghua, ‘Inau tu mua ghilalaghau, ivei tau va butu mai. Kau tona keha itagua, ighau na vure dika.’
Mi vei kau nia na tangi mana girigiri livo tana bona kau righira a Abraham, ma Isaac, ma Jacob, ma rana lei prophet tana Kinakabuna God, tana bona kara sonihorughau!
Mana vuresubo kara va mai ulu, mi boko, i lau, mi longa, ma kara sopou ni vanga koukolu tana kinakabuna God.
Keri ge gaira kiri tara tumuri taeni kara ide, ma gaira tara ide itaeni, kara tumuri.”
Jesus te dolovia Jerusalem
Mi tana bona keri na balu Pharisee tara mai ta Jesus, mara bosa vania, “Ko tona keha tua iani, mo ko tona siki bona, na pukuna Herod Antipas te liona ge ke mategho!”

Ma Jesus te bosa tughu vanira, “Kau tona ma kau va bosa vania Herod te vaghaa na kau asi, ‘Inau tu ghuruhorura lei tidalo dika, mu kisu volara itaeni mi ropo, mi tana toluni na bongi ge ku sokoa na lutugu.
Hauvaa, ku mua taho tua na sakutua itaeni, mi ropo, mi valiha, na pukuna te mua uto ge kara matea na prophet tana komu keha, mi Jerusalem mughua.’

“Jerusalem, Jerusalem! Ighau tau matera rana prophet, mau petara tara ladavaghinia na bosa te vetenara vanighau nia God! Inau tu liona haia tua na righitaoniadira lei dalemu, vaghaa na kudo te ghoro haghera dalena sara ni ghatana, hauvaa, mau mua talagu!
Keri gaia ge ohua nimua na Valetabu. Inau tu bosa utuni vanighau, kau mua ghoi righiu polo ke sara mai na bona ni aho ge kau bosa, ‘God ke vautoa gaia te mai tana ahana Lord God.’”
